description:
Have you ever wondered the meaning of Isaiah 8:11-22 or just needed more clarification? If so then join us for this episode of 3ABN Today Bible Q & A as Jill Morikone hosts Pastor John Lomacang, Daniel Perrin, and Daniel Morikone. They may just be answering the question you submitted.

Send us your Bible Questions! 
By email: BibleQA@3abn.org 
By text: (618) 228-3975

QUESTIONS COVERED:

1. Will we all have to stand before God and give an account for our sins whether it be good or bad? 

2. When Malachi 4 speaks of Elijah the prophet must first come before that great and dreadful day of the Lord, can you explain exactly what that means? Can you please explain Malachi 4:5?

3. Will the heavenly sanctuary remain standing after the new world is created? 


4. What is the Biblical view of drinking coffee? 

5. Can 777 be used in things like email addresses, bank card pin numbers, etc? My grandma says 777 is only for the cross and should never be used on worldly things, can you shed some light on this matter, please? Can we use the numbers 777? 

6. Is it a sin to indulge in sex before marriage? 

7.  Was Satan raining down fire on Job? 

8. Since the Mark of the beast and the Mark of God are not physically visible, how will store owners know who to sell to and who not to sell to? 

9. Why does the Bible use Holy Spirit in some places and Holy Ghost in other places? 

10. What does Isaiah 8:11-22 mean? 

11. Why is Matthew 17:21 left out of some Bible translations? 

12. In reference to Revelation 2:17, will everyone who goes to Heaven get a white stone?
